1: # PatientGPT storage, identity, and deployment team research
2: 
3: Observed 2026-10-04. Phase: spec / bootstrap ready. Scope: team design and dependency research only; no application, dependency, cluster, or workflow changes. Confidence below describes inspected source, not runtime acceptance.
4: 
5: The useful reuse boundary is the shell-independent `aso_host::AppServices` and its domain ports. Forge's database abstraction, Fabric's replication stores, and the browser entity graph serve different responsibilities. They are not interchangeable clinical databases. The uncomfortable thing is that the requested desktop SurrealDB 3.3.0 direction differs from the inherited desktop SQLite preference, while the inherited browser materializer is explicitly blocked. Assign an owner to reconcile and prove each boundary before declaring storage integration ready.
6: 
7: ## Current boundaries and contradictions
8: 
9: | Boundary | Evidence and consequence | Confidence |
10: |---|---|---|
11: | Shared clinical application core | `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/TribeHealth/kevin/prior-auth/crates/aso-host/src/lib.rs:36-48` exposes `AppServices` with case/evidence/criteria/letter/authority/session ports. `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/TribeHealth/kevin/prior-auth/crates/aso-host/src/ports/mod.rs:23,169,352,450,630` defines corresponding traits. Desktop uses that same service type at `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/TribeHealth/kevin/prior-auth/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs:17,45`. Keep shared Rust domain and authorization behavior here; shell adapters supply transport/storage. | High, source |
12: | Forge authoritative database | `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/flint-forge/crates/fdb-ports/src/lib.rs:96-142` defines `DatabaseBackend` as RLS-scoped connection acquisition and SQL execution. Its transaction contract requires explicit commit for mutations. `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/flint-forge/crates/fdb-postgres/src/backend.rs:17-60` supplies a Postgres pool and transaction-local role/claims/header context. This is a server Postgres abstraction, not evidence of a PGlite/SurrealDB clinical adapter. | High, source |
13: | Browser PGlite | `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/TribeHealth/kevin/prior-auth/web/src/shared/sync/pglite-bootstrap.ts:22-44` opens PGlite memory or IndexedDB; `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/TribeHealth/kevin/prior-auth/web/src/shared/sync/storage-policy.ts:47-92` defaults to memory and rejects experimental clinical materialization in persistent mode. `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/TribeHealth/kevin/prior-auth/web/src/app/providers/graph-provider.tsx:122-135,377-410` scopes stores by deployment, schema generation, principal, practice, identity, session, and authorization revision; disabled materialization enters `offline-limited`. | High, source |
14: | Browser adoption block | `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/TribeHealth/kevin/prior-auth/versions.toml:85-87` records unsupported `log=full` for PGlite Sync and a 1,016,692,736-byte incremental RSS measurement against a 536,870,912-byte cap for the internal adapter. Production adoption remains blocked. These are recorded prior measurements, not rerun results. Do not market reuse as a finished replica. | High for recorded decision; not freshly measured |
15: | Desktop storage | `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/TribeHealth/kevin/prior-auth/docs/architecture/tauri-pglite-baseline.md:6-12,80-108` describes PGlite as a measured native baseline, host-owned SQLite as its preferred eventual production target, and persistent clinical adoption as blocked. User-selected embedded SurrealDB 3.3.0 therefore needs an explicit PatientGPT decision and adapter; do not silently substitute SQLite or browser PGlite. | High, source |
16: | Fabric stores | `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/flint-realtime-fabric/crates/frf-ports/src/entity_store.rs:53-118` is tenant-scoped projection read/watch, atomic state/cursor application, and snapshot recovery. `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/flint-realtime-fabric/crates/frf-store-surreal/src/store.rs:13-45` implements CRDT checkpoints. `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/flint-realtime-fabric/crates/frf-projection-surreal/src/store.rs:31-59` connects a Surreal-backed projection with namespace/database and root authentication. These are replication/projection adapters; neither proves native PatientGPT clinical persistence. | High, source |
17: | SurrealDB version | Fabric `Cargo.toml:163` and `Cargo.lock:9496-9499` both select 3.1.5. Official [3.3.0 release](https://github.com/surrealdb/surrealdb/releases/tag/v3.3.0) exists. Context7 returned official embedded-Rust docs but mixed `kv-surrealkv` examples with older `storage-surrealkv` v2 performance examples. Exact 3.3.0 feature/API compatibility remains unverified; never copy the older example as a pin. | High version discrepancy; medium API fit |
